name: query_user_feedback_symptom_trend
description: Gets trend counts grouped by symptom for a specified time window.

agentId.description: Required. Unique identifier of the agent/partner.

firstDate.description: Required. Starting calendar day in "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC). Filters for issues occurring on or after this date.

lastDate.description: Required. Ending calendar day in "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC). INCLUSIVE: Filters for issues occurring on or before this calendar date.

symptoms.description: Optional. Filter trend series to a specific symptom type. If unspecified, trends for all observed symptom types are returned in the dictionary.

x-google-enum-descriptions: Ghost success symptom where device state did not change.
Ghost success symptom where device state mismatched.
